verdict.rationale: Runpod documents per-second billing across the platform: Pods are billed by the second for compute and storage, and all compute charges are per second. Serverless workers are billed only from when a worker starts until it fully stops, rounded to the nearest second, and Flex workers scale to zero when idle. missing for 10: an explicit statement that stopped Pods incur no compute charges (and whether storage is still charged while stopped), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the billing behavior.
